scope: sum of solver_run CUDA-event intervals, including operator/Newton setup, extra evaluations and host gaps; excludes outer stage setup, interstage transfer, process startup and output
interval: 95% paired percentile bootstrap, 20000 resamples, seed20260908; exploratory per-case intervals, not adjusted for multiple comparisons
followup_selection: initial 95% interval width >10 percentage points, regardless of gain sign; 15 fresh pairs, separate from initial5

metric_definitions.geometry: Plain physical Rcc cosine and Zsc sine synthesis on max(256,8*mpol) equal native poloidal angles; no additional sqrt(s) or basis normalization.
metric_definitions.near_axis: All coefficient and R/Z surface comparisons exclude full-grid j=0 only. Axis R00 difference is separate. Native B² and Jacobian checks include every half-grid point, including the innermost half surface.
metric_definitions.l2: norm(candidate-reference)/norm(reference), over all compared modes/surfaces or angular grid points. max_abs is the largest absolute element difference.
metric_definitions.geometry_displacement: sqrt((R_candidate-R_reference)^2+(Z_candidate-Z_reference)^2), in metres; maximum and unweighted RMS over non-axis surfaces and synthesis angles.
metric_definitions.lambda_coefficients: Lsc physical solver coefficient amplitudes; zero Lcs/null parity families are separately checked. VMEC lmns_full is folded and multiplied by phipF/lamscale, with lamscale=sqrt(sum(phipH^2)/(ns-1)); conversion independently checked against stored internal lambda.
metric_definitions.b_squared: Native half-grid B^s B_s + B^theta B_theta + B^zeta B_zeta, in tesla squared; no interpolation.
metric_definitions.volume: 4*pi²*mean(abs(sqrtg)) over native half surfaces and angles, in cubic metres.
metric_definitions.gauge: R/Z and B² comparisons use equal native coordinate labels without gauge alignment. Numerical differences are diagnostics; no blanket equivalence threshold is imposed.
metric_definitions.iteration_accounting: Native RunReport proves preserved configured schedules and effective iteration caps; actual trial/full evaluation counts are provided separately by benchmark telemetry.

vmecpp.b_squared_comparison: Not assessed against VMEC++; matching postprocessing conventions was outside this qualification. Native candidate-baseline B² is checked.

replay.required: One iteration, original final tolerance/cap and identical non-stage physics; exact state bits except signed zeros only at j=0,m>0. All active, boundary and nonzero values retain exact bits.
replay.residual_equality: Diagnostic only: a fresh epoch may recompute force-normalization factors. Original tolerance is the gate.

sanitizer.pascal_cuda121_initcheck_graphs: unresolved PCR pivot-scale initialization reports; baseline reproduces before Newton; full candidate run timed out at180s
sanitizer.scale_probe: fresh graph/direct and NaN-poisoned refresh scales exactly match CPU bandmax; graph/direct bands and residual slabs match; CUDA12.1 initcheck still reports PCR reads
